title: lakeland 2 Moth Stop Clothes & Carpet Moth Detector & Trap Refills – Active For Up To 8 Weeks
bullet_points: Refills for the Moth Detector and Trap
Two sticky pads with end-of-life indicators
description:
When your Moth Stop Moth Detector & Trap has stopped working, this pack of two replacement sticky pads will bring it back to male moth-attracting life for another 8 weeks – just slide out the old pad from your existing unit, and slide in one of these new ones.

About our Moth Stop Moth Detector & Trap

Adapting the principle used in traditional flypaper, our Moth Detector & Trap releases pheromones to attract adult male moths and then traps them on its large sticky pad, breaking the cycle of moth breeding and stopping the females laying eggs, which then hatch out into the larvae that do all the damage.

It can be used free-standing or hanging in any moth ‘danger area’, like wardrobes, or behind the sofa. The pad remains effective for up to 8 weeks, and when it’s time to slot in a replacement one, the end-of-life indicator will let you know.

And if you do find moths stuck to it, it’s time to invest in the rest of our range – the Clothes and Carpet Sprays that will get rid of the females as well as the males.

Refill Packs containing two replacement pads and two end-of-life indicators also available.

Use pesticides safely. Always read the label and the product information before use.

About our Moth Stop range

The trouble with moths is that you don't know they're nibbling away until it's too late. That's why it's important to detect the problem early, so your first sign of an infestation is a trap full of moths, rather than a jumper full of holes. Then you can move in with the moth repellent.

It isn't just clothes that these pests like to snack on. So we've covered all bases with our Carpet Moth Killer & Freshener Spray, and our Fabric Moth Killer & Freshener Spray, both of which are fragranced to freshen carpets and clothes, as well as saving them from being eaten.
